question: What changes when Alpine freight moves from trucks to the Turin–Lyon rail line?
answer: Moving Alpine freight from road to the Turin–Lyon rail line would take about 1 million heavy trucks off Alpine roads. Fewer trucks burning diesel would mean roughly 3 million tonnes less CO₂ every year.
move: Freight on rail: ~1 million fewer trucks on Alpine roads, ~3 million t less CO₂ a year.
